jobs.title: iOS Engineer - Design System
jobs.description: About the team: As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale. The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide. What you'll do: Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health You'll be a great fit for this role if you: Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable Take pride in crafting accessible us

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.description: Introduction: A UX/UI Designer is a professional who combines expertise in user experience and user interface design. This role requires a deep understanding of design principles, user behavior, and the ability to create visually appealing and highly functional interfaces that meet both user needs and business objectives. You synchronize directly with leading positions based on the teams you are part of. You report to Department Manager, Product Design Responsibilities Execute UX/UI strategy and vision for projects or product areas Taking responsibility for end-to-end user experience and interface design process within an assigned design project or product area Conduct user research, usability testing, and data analysis in collaboration with and according to Product Design Strategy Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs Contributes to the maintenance of the design systems and style guides Mentor junior designers and contribute to the team’s growth Present design solutions to stakeholders and defend design decisions based on Product Design Strategy Ownership Be accountable for the quality and consistency of design deliverables Take charge of the UX/UI roadmap within assigned projects or product areas Implement and maintain UX/UI best practices and standards according to industry standards Responsible for ensuring that design outcomes meet relevant accessibility guidelines Take responsibility for personal growth, goal setting, and skill development Impact Drive improvements in key UX/UI metrics and KPIs for the projects or product area Contribute to design processes that lead to positive user experience, engagement, and retention Influence product strategy based on research insights and innovative design solutions Enhance the overall quality and consistency of the user experience and design solutions Foster a human-centered design culture within the organization Talent Continuously improve personal design skills and stay updated with industry

We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. jobs.title: Principal Designer
jobs.description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team In Product and Design, we bring together product managers, product designers and service designers in a central team covering the breadth of Faculty’s Applied AI division. In partnership with our Business Units, we form multidisciplinary teams and work with data scientists, engineers and delivery colleagues to create durable AI-powered software solutions for clients across a variety of industries. Both product management and design are critical disciplines to create impact with AI. While data science and machine learning offer a powerful means to build insight and predictive capability, those insights are often consumed within a complex operational environment where human and organisational factors determine whether solutions are adopted and ultimately successful. Closing the gap between the outputs of a model and the outcomes desired by our clients requires us to go beyond data and technology to address the human side – product and design are critical to this. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Security
jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we ve grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.  Information about the position  IMPORTANT - this role is initially offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension depending on business needs. We see design as a crucial element of achieving our mission, so designers are represented at all levels, including senior leadership. As our new Senior Product Designer, you will be empowered to concentrate on design solutions for people’s needs. The design organisation is well established and our impact is highly valued. jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. Your Profile MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it.
